findings.description: The translated execution covers only the three-wave import/filter/hourly Google Analytics merge and unadjusted Table 2 Panel A. It does not translate and execute the full 2,610-line shipped pipeline, including wave 2 preparation, all remaining tables and figures, LASSO analyses, and dofile 3 text-number calculations.
findings.evidence: Executed code is code/translated_core.R; logs/core_run.txt ends by stating the run covers only that translation.
findings.suggested_fix: Complete a command-by-command R translation of the remaining shipped do-files and rerun before treating this as a complete certification.

findings.description: The translated survey filters retain 2,533 respondents, four fewer than the article's reported 2,537; the third treatment mean for sharing intention is 10.9% rather than 10.8%.
findings.evidence: logs/core_run.txt reports n=844, 845, 844 and translated means 14.7%, 10.2%, 10.9%.
findings.suggested_fix: Trace the observation-level difference against the shipped Stata import semantics and update the direct translation only if the Stata behavior is established; do not change sample criteria.

limitations: This is an incomplete benchmark-mode check. No claim is made that every data-derived result in the abstract, main text or tables has been checked.

Only Tables 2 Panel A core unadjusted estimates and several introductory counts were recomputed. Other numerical claims are omitted from results because the corresponding shipped analysis blocks were not executed; this does not satisfy the requested exhaustive claim inventory.
Results are marked translated because Stata/MP 16.1 is unavailable. The R run uses the local package copy in place and does not copy or upload original code or data.
outcome_robustness is not checked; this certificate reports computational reproducibility only.
